persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.
bank.Deliverables and sizes: Two separate 10-second videos: one 9:16 for Stories and one 16:9 for a venue screen.
bank.Exact event text: Rooftop Jazz; 18 July 2026; Sky Terrace, Manchester
bank.Visual style: Musicians playing on a rooftop at sunset, with matching styling across both versions.
bank.Audio: Mellow jazz in both versions, no voiceover.

messages.text: I need the same Rooftop Jazz promo made in two versions, and I’m probably over-explaining because I want to be clear about what I mean. I’m a little worried about how it will look when it’s shown in such different places. The scene should be a rooftop at sunset with musicians playing, and somewhere in all of this the practical bit is that both videos need to be 10 seconds long, with one in 9:16 for Stories and the other in 16:9 for a venue screen. For the sound, I want mellow jazz in both versions and no voiceover. The text to show is 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Please make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.
